name: mirage
text: On it, two builds. (1) CLV (CH57): the engine's grader will gather every close it already holds (no new API calls), reject a close that disagrees with the others, and only count a bet as beating the close when two sources agree or one sharp source is clean; it gets a CLV-confirmed flag on every bet and bid record. (2) API quality (CH58): the engine will save, per API and per day, how fast, how fresh, how often it answered, how close to Pinnacle and Novig's close it was, and how much of the final fair line it supplied, plus its cost. From that I'll write you a keep / drop / buy table, including whether ParlayAPI's websocket tier is worth it. I'll tell you here when each ships.
